sketch.name: GridBoard
sketch.description: A dashboard board: section tabs, an edit toggle and a widget catalog over a 12-column grid whose widgets host real Wisej controls and can be dragged, resized, collapsed, recoloured and removed.
sketch.html: Collapse all Expand all

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of grid columns in the widest layout.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of one grid row, in pixels.

props.name: editMode
props.description: Widgets can be dragged and resized; the grid backdrop, Add widget and + show.

props.name: showToolbar
props.description: Shows the Edit button, the section tabs and the Collapse all / Expand all links.

props.name: selectedSection
props.description: Id of the section whose widgets show.

props.name: selected
props.description: Id of the selected widget (sketch only; outlined only in edit mode).

props.name: sections
props.description: The board's sections, shown as underlined tabs with a count of their widgets.

props.name: catalog
props.description: The kinds of widget Add widget offers.

props.name: widgets
props.description: Sketch only: stands for the GridWidget child controls (ItemId, Section, Chrome, Title, Icon, Color, Buttons, GridX/Y/W/H, Collapsed, FooterText).

sketch.notes: Restyled to the GridKrafter MVC demo look (dark sketch tokens = GridKrafter-Dark): Edit toggle (small outlined, pencil) above underlined section tabs with grey count badges and a 1 px line; right-aligned Collapse all / Expand all links (muted when nothing to do); Add widget and + only in edit mode. Cards: window surface, 1 px windowFrame border, 8 px radius, 3 px top edge in the widget colour, 34 px header with a 16 px line icon in the widget colour, 13 px normal title, 16 px line buttons (refresh, color, edit, fullscreen, collapse, close) muted, accent on hover, no header divider. Plain tiles: same surface with a 3 px left edge in the widget colour; colour/delete pop-up only in edit mode. GridWidget.FooterText (string): right-aligned small muted line under the body. Gap 12; dotted backdrop, grips, selection outline and drag only in edit mode. Colours from theme names: window, windowFrame, grayText, highlight, blue/green/orange/violet/amber/sky/red/pink (mixin fallbacks for themes without them). Edit button raises Changed kind "edit"; Collapse all / Expand all raise Changed "collapsed-all" / "expanded-all". Server: GridBoard Columns/RowHeight/Gap/EditMode/ShowToolbar/SelectedSection/Sections/Catalog, LoadBoard/ToBoard/AddWidget/RemoveWidget/FindWidget/SetFullscreen; events Changed, LayoutChanged, WidgetRefresh, AddWidgetRequested, SectionAdding (unchanged). Earlier parts plan: GridWidgetChrome enum, GridBoardSection(+Collection), GridWidgetKind(+Collection), event args classes; layout server-side by GridKrafter.Core GridEngine/BoardArranger.
